games.name: Unboxing Simulator [UPDATE]
games.desc:
🎁 Welcome to Unboxing Simulator 🎁
Smash boxes, uncover legendary loot, and flex your finds with friends!

[How To Play]
• Open boxes to get hats
• Equip your best hats and weapon to boost damage
• Unlock new worlds, hatch pets, and find even stronger hats
• Visit the Trade Plaza to swap epic items with other players
• Equip perks for powerful effects - some spawn extra boxes, others upgrade or even smash them for you

[Tips]
• Bigger gifts = rarer loot - team up for locked crates!
• Reach Area 3 to hatch pets - pets help you find stronger hats from boxes
• A Locked Crate spawns every 15 min - team up to crack it open for random OP loot like perks or potions

Happy smashing and good luck on the loot!

games.name: Stick Fight: Roblox Edition
games.desc:
(UNOFFICIAL/EXPERIMENTAL: PRONE TO ISSUES)

(⚠️DISCLAIMER⚠️) This is a recreation of Landfall/Landfall West's "Stick Fight: The Game" which is available on PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch. In-game music was created by Karl Flodin for the original Stick Fight: The Game. If you want an experience that's made by actual good developers, the original Stick Fight: The Game is only $4.99.

This game makes Roblox into a 2D game, so expect bugs and issues. Certain aspects like server performance and mobile support are not the best, so it's highly recommended to play in a Private Server if you can.

Controls:
Left Click / R2 & X Button = Attack
Right Click & F / L2 = Block
F / Y Button = Throw Weapon
A & D / Left Joystick = Movement
W & Space / A Button & L1 = Jump
S / Left Joystick Down = Crouch
